name: Unmatched recording
description: A call recording came in that matched no contact or booking: the team is told in the alerts channel (else bookings) with the meeting, why it did not match, who was on it and the link to match it by hand. Matching it on the recordings page links it and Sales call recorded runs as if it had matched on arrival. Was the engine's own post (D88).

nodes.label: ghost
nodes.title: Tell the team a recording matched nobody
Jev: a sales call with a prospect? (D237: only those are posted)
nodes.question: What kind of recording is this?

criteria.sales_call: A sales conversation with a prospect: someone who is not yet a client, talking with the team about buying or starting the program.
criteria.internal: Team members talking to each other: a standup, training, role-play, a vendor call.
criteria.other: Anything else: a session with someone who is already a client (coaching, onboarding, a check-in), a voicemail, a wrong number, a personal call, an unrelated meeting.

nodes.title: Posted unless clearly not a sales call (a client's session, the team, anything else)
